integrity: Self-contained analytic proof with supplemental rational and numerical convex-hull checker; finite experiments are not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Exact lifting requires a nondegenerate convex pyramid. Rogers–Shephard upper bound and mixed-volume polynomial are prior results; historical priority of the pyramid-specific lift is not exhaustively confirmed, and no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Exact mixed-volume lifting and sharp difference-body bounds for convex pyramids
